items.label: Oregon CLC bond, small contractor
items.source: ORS 658.415(3)(a), 2025 edition, oregonlegislature.gov/bills_laws/ors/ors658.html: bond for a labor contractor with the smaller employee band. Used in 04 checklist B4
items.note: ORS 658.415(3)(a) 2025 ed: $10,000 if no more than 20 employees

items.label: Oregon CLC bond, larger contractor
items.source: ORS 658.415(3)(b), 2025 edition: bond for the larger employee band (before any commissioner reduction under 658.416). Used in 04 checklist B4
items.note: ORS 658.415(3)(b) 2025 ed: $30,000 (or lesser per 658.416) if 21 or more employees

items.label: Oregon CLC bond band ceiling
items.source: ORS 658.415(3)(a), 2025 edition: maximum employees for the smaller bond band. Used in 04 checklist B4
items.note: ORS 658.415(3)(a) 2025 ed: no more than 20 employees

items.label: Florida E-Verify employee threshold
items.source: Fla. Stat. 448.095 (private employers), and plan doc Regulatory Map, Florida row. Used in 04 checklist B1 and 05 memo item 7
items.note: Fla. Stat. 448.095(2)(b)2: private employer with 25 or more employees from 1 Jul 2023; plan doc FL row 25+
